completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Resolve a damage event

Resolve each genuinely separate hit or damage event once. Do not split one packet to multiply Wound saves or combine separate hits merely to cross a threshold. Feature-specific prevention that acts before damage or before reaching zero resolves at its printed timing first.

1. Resolve attack/save, damage and applicable defenses. The remaining nonnegative amount is **resolved damage**.
2. Record HP, Wounds and zero-HP state before the event. Remove temporary HP first. **Post-temp damage = resolved damage minus temporary HP absorbed.** Keep this amount even when it exceeds current HP; floor the resulting current HP at zero.
3. Check V6 Instant Death. If post-temp damage minus HP before the hit is at least maximum HP, the creature dies. For a creature already at zero, this is post-temp damage at least maximum HP. Stop: there is no Wound save, death-save failure or successful knockout from that event.
4. Otherwise, a living creature makes one Wound save if it dropped from positive HP to zero, if **2 × post-temp damage is at least maximum HP**, or if the effect actually inflicts Maiming. Overlapping triggers still cause only one save. The post-temp threshold and one-save rule are new provisional interpretations. Maiming is an independent trigger even when temporary HP absorbs all ordinary damage; immunity to Maiming itself still applies.
5. Make a Constitution save against **max(10, floor(post-temp damage / 2))**. Use pre-event Wounds for the -1-per-Wound penalty. Maiming with zero post-temp damage uses DC 10. A Wound gained now cannot penalize the roll that created it.
6. A success adds no Wound. A failure that began with zero, one or two Wounds adds exactly one; failure by 5 or more also gives that Wound one Injury. A failure that began with three Wounds kills the creature instead: no fourth Wound and no Injury roll. Stop processing later living-target consequences if dead.
7. If the creature was already at zero before this event and post-temp damage is positive, end Stable. A creature using death saves adds one failure, or two for a critical hit; three failures kill it. An ordinary creature that does not use death saves dies instead, without starting death counters. A hit from positive HP to zero does not also cause a same-packet death failure.
8. If this event newly reduces positive HP to zero, a valid melee knockout makes the surviving creature Stable. Otherwise a character/significant NPC using death saves begins dying; an ordinary monster dies. A previously Stable creature whose temporary HP absorbed all damage remains Stable unless an independent Maiming result killed it. The Director identifies significant NPCs consistently. Knockout cannot override Instant Death or a fatal Wound save.

Core's Maiming and Wound trigger rules remain subject to an actual feature's eligibility. The reference helper receives already legal events; it does not grant every attack Maiming or a damage-prevention exception.

## Zero HP and recovery

A living character at zero HP is Unconscious. Core's condition already includes Incapacitated, unawareness, dropping held items and falling Prone; an adjacent hit is critical as specified there. Healing does not silently remove other independent causes of Unconscious or Prone.

While dying, make one death save at the **start of each regular initiative turn**. Roll d20 without modifiers unless a feature specifically modifies death saves. Natural 20 restores 1 HP; natural 1 adds two failures. Other results of 10 or more add one success; 9 or less add one failure. Three successes make the creature Stable; three failures make it Dead. Extra turns and Actions add no extra death saves. Stable or Dead creatures do not roll them.

Regaining positive HP or becoming Stable resets both counters. Temporary HP does not raise normal HP, end Unconscious or reset counters. Fully absorbed damage does not end Stable or add a death failure in this provisional interpretation. Independent Maiming can still cause its Wound save.

**Stabilize:** an Action and DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check, or an Action using one healer's-kit use automatically, stabilizes a living dying creature at zero. It remains Unconscious and makes no death saves. Roll 1d4 once when it becomes Stable and record its absolute recovery time that many hours later. If still Stable then, it regains 1 HP. Damage reaching normal HP cancels that deadline and resumes dying with the appropriate failures. Rest and Stable recovery use the same elapsed clock, so four hours of recovery inside an eight-hour Watch do not cost twelve hours. A later rest does not separately replay the Stable healing event.

**Dead:** ordinary healing and stabilization do not restore life. Resurrection must satisfy its own willing-soul, body, time, cost and target rules. It does not automatically remove Wounds, Corruption, debts, legal death or claims upon the body. Corpses cannot supply repeated resource triggers.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Rolls

Choose the roll type before rolling. Use the actual ability modifier, including negative values, and normal proficiency only when applicable. Existing advantage/disadvantage chooses the higher/lower of two d20s; multiple sources do not stack, and any advantage plus disadvantage cancels. Add other legal modifiers once. Fractions round down unless a rule specifies otherwise. One tile is 5 feet. Class L, S and effect M retain their definitions in the shared class rules.

**Attack:** roll d20 plus the appropriate attack modifier against AC. Meeting AC hits. Natural 1 always misses; natural 20 always hits and critically doubles damage dice, not flat modifiers. Beating AC by 10 is not a critical hit. An explicit broader critical range does not stack with another; use the broadest eligible range. In this overlay, a natural result below 20 in that range must still meet AC unless the feature expressly says it always hits.

**Task, skill or tool check against a fixed DC:** total at least DC+10 is Critical Success; at least DC is Success; at most DC-10 is Critical Failure; other totals below DC are Failure. Natural 20 then improves one degree and natural 1 worsens one, bounded at either end. A task printing only success/failure collapses the two upper degrees to success and two lower degrees to failure; no extra consequence is invented. A natural 20 can still fail an otherwise impossible check, and a natural 1 with sufficient modifiers can still succeed.

**Saving throw:** total at least DC succeeds; otherwise it fails. Natural 1 and 20 have no generic special outcome. A printed failure by 5 or 10 compares the final total with the DC; it does not add an unprinted critical-save system. Death saves are the specific exception below.

**Opposed check, new provisional tie rule:** compare final totals. Higher wins; an exact tie leaves the existing state unchanged, so the initiating creature fails to change it. Do not turn task natural shifts into hidden numeric modifiers. A maneuver explicitly printing degree outcomes must specify how those apply.

## Targets, concentration and control

Unless expressly stated, perceive the target, remain within range and have line of effect; total cover blocks targeting. “Ally” includes self unless it says OTHER. A list cannot contain a creature twice. Select up to the printed limit; an empty target list is not a valid way to farm activation benefits. Zones remain at their chosen point unless described as an aura; allies can leave and lose their benefits. An aura requires its owner conscious unless the card supplies a bounded exception. An effect ending at “end next turn” means the affected creature's next turn only when the card says target's; otherwise the user's.

One concentration slot for all spells, Chants, Veinweaves, forms or zones that require concentration. Starting another ends the old before the new effect resolves, except for an explicit limited linked-effect rule. Damage prompts CON save against max(10, floor(damage/2)); incapacitation or a failed save ends concentration. The round-down convention is a deliberate pilot interpretation. Concentration does not demand a Bonus Action unless maintenance says so. For a paid 3-pulse effect, start is pulse 1; pay maintenance on each of the next 2 regular turns by turn end for pulses 2/3. Missing payment ends it at that turn's end; otherwise it ends at start of turn 4. No repeated start triggers on maintenance.

Forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks unless explicitly stated, cannot place a creature inside solid matter, and stops at an obstacle. Grapples use the card's save/DC, can be escaped with an Action and STR(Athletics) or DEX(Acrobatics) against that DC, and end beyond reach. A root sets Speed 0 but does not remove Actions. Slows reduce Speed to minimum 0. Silence blocks verbal spells/audible abilities, not all thought or all class features. Charmed effects never determine a player's beliefs; use only the printed action restrictions.

No repeated hard denial without a new save and cost. For this class suite, a creature can suffer **Stunned, compelled loss of its whole Action/turn, or equivalent hard denial from a given character at most once per encounter**, across that character's class features; later such riders fail while damage and soft riders resolve normally. Record source and target. This draft guard is broader than the older Oracle-only ceiling and is an explicit balance proposal. Reaction denial, Speed reduction, penalties and Frightened do not count as whole-turn loss. Do not silently waive boss immunities, legendary defenses or anatomy.

### Null Veil

**Duration.** Persists until one listed purge succeeds. Exiting field alone does not end it.

**Passive Insight.** While Veil is active and not suppressed, final passive Insight is 5. This is a setting of that passive score, not omniscience or motive detection. Suppression restores normal calculation for its duration.

**Creation-time nonlethal damage flag.** At creation of each damage root, record root dealer. If that dealer is a character currently under unsuppressed Null Veil, mark the entire root `nullNonlethal=true`. Descendant delayed/ongoing packets inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A distinct later activation/attack creates a new root and re-evaluates. A companion/minion has its own dealer identity. Controller Veil does not convert companion damage unless an exact ability says the controller is the damage dealer. Pure transfer/redirection keeps the original root's nullNonlethal flag. It does not create a second root or extra prevention/resource triggers. An effect that explicitly creates new reflected/retaliatory damage uses the reflector as dealer and evaluates that new root at creation. A mere transfer is not reflection.

When a root is qualifying Null-nonlethal, use this order:

1. Snapshot recipient identity/lifecycle, pre-event HP/tempHP/Wounds/death state and the root nullNonlethal flag. Resolve ordinary defenses, resistance and temp-HP absorption and calculate the ordinary post-temp damage/HP loss values; attached non-damage riders remain pending under their own triggers.
2. If nullNonlethal is false, use the ordinary CORE/HEALING_DEATH/lifecycle procedure unchanged. If true, continue below. Objects/noncreature structures still take ordinary object damage and can be destroyed; the word nonlethal does not make objects indestructible.
3. For any living-recipient qualifying damage packet, suppress damage-caused Instant Death and suppress the packet’s Core Wound/Maiming save entirely, including half-maximum and positive-HP Wound triggers. Therefore the packet cannot create a fatal fourth-Wound result while the recipient remains above 0 or reaches 0. Existing Wounds remain recorded.
4. Apply normal HP loss down to minimum 0. Positive→positive: stop the Null zero-state branch; recipient keeps resulting positive HP, existing Wounds/conditions and independent riders. Positive→0 ordinary living: skip damage-caused death/death-save failures and establish Stable0 with counters reset and exactly one ordinary Stable recovery deadline, unless a source-specific zero-HP permission such as actual Undying Spellform applies as stated below.
5. Already Dying0: qualifying damage causes no new damage failure/death and does not stabilize, clear counters or move the existing death-save schedule. Already Stable0: causes no failure/death and keeps the existing recovery deadline exactly; never reroll/extend it. If temp HP absorbs the entire normal-HP loss so HP never reaches0, no zero-state transition occurs.
6. For nonliving/companion/projection recipients, use exactly one explicit recipientLifecycle branch below; do not infer anatomy from a name. The Null override replaces only the damage-caused lethal/destruction endpoint named by that branch. Independent duration, dismissal, concentration/source end, sacrifice/cost, Hunt finality or other non-damage expiry remains real.
7. Would-die/death-trigger protections do not trigger or spend if their prerequisite death/fatal branch was skipped by Null. A source-specific trigger keyed only to damage reducing HP to0 without killing, such as actual Undying Spellform, still triggers. Independent non-damage riders resolve if their own trigger remains true and they do not require a Wound/death result.
8. Direct HP payments/sacrificial costs are not damage and are never converted. New reflected/retaliatory damage that is a new root re-evaluates its own dealer; pure transfer/redirection preserves the original root flag and does not duplicate root triggers.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
### Recipient lifecycles for qualifying Null damage

**Ordinary living recipient.** Use orderedAlgorithm steps 3–5. Positive→positive: no packet-created Wound/Instant Death. New positive→0: Stable0 unless an exact source-specific zero permission overrides. Already Dying0: same counters/markers. Already Stable0: same recovery deadline.

**Ranger Beast.** Source normally dies immediately at0. Qualifying Null damage replaces that damage-caused immediate-death transition with Null Disabled at0: Incapacitated, Speed0, no commands/actions; same animal/bond remains. Ordinary legal companion healing above0 ends Disabled. A later independent non-damage death/removal rule still works.

**Finite summon, Familiar or Mirror Beast.** Source normally disappears/ends at0. Qualifying Null damage replaces only that damage-caused zero disappearance with Null Disabled at0 while its original duration/source still exists. Independent duration expiry, dismissal, concentration/source end or replacement still ends it. Legal companion healing above0 restores function; no generic repair/resummon is granted.

**Mage Lich elite.** Source normally becomes destroyed bound asset at0. Qualifying Null damage leaves same elite Null Disabled at0, not destroyed; therefore Soulbound is not legal solely from this zero. Legal companion healing above0 restores it. An independent actual destruction/expiry can later create its normal destroyed state.

**Wizard standard undead.** Qualifying Null damage leaves same minion Null Disabled at0 instead of damage-caused destruction. Dismissal or owner completed-LR expiry still ends it. Legal healing above0 if a real source applies may restore it.

**Authored local projection.** A scene projection whose authored 0-HP rule says disperse/end uses that administrative projection endpoint even under Null; it is not a living death/Wound branch. ACT-FEAST-STEWARD instead uses its explicit Collapsed Projection rule. This classification must be printed in the actor profile, not inferred from a name.

**Undying Spellform.** If qualifying damage newly reduces a Mage with actual Undying Spellform to0 without killing outright, its printed trigger occurs and its 1/LR use is spent. It overrides zero-HP Unconscious/Incapacitated permissions as reviewed: conscious, half-Speed voluntary movement, normal Action, legal spellcasting/concentration, no independent BA/Reaction. Triggering damage still causes its concentration save. If still0 at feature expiry, the reviewed expiry destabilizes/cancels Stable recovery and adds one failed death save; that later feature-expiry event is not the original Null damage packet.

**Would-die protections.** A protection whose trigger requires actual death/would-die/fatal result does not trigger and spends no use when Null skips that damage-caused death branch. Do not replay it later. Separate minimum-HP prevention that resolves earlier follows its own source if actually triggered.

**Actual nonliving Construct.** For an actual nonliving Construct creature with an authored HP/destruction endpoint, qualifying Null damage reducing it to0 replaces only damage-caused destruction with Null Disabled0: Incapacitated, Speed0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions/commands. Same construct identity remains; no corpse/parts/loot are generated by the zero. Only an actual repair/heal rule that expressly applies to that construct can raise it above0 and end Disabled; no generic repair is granted.

**Silence Wraith only.** For ACT-SILENCE-WRAITH specifically, qualifying Null damage reducing it to0 replaces its damage-caused dispersal with Null Disabled0 (Incapacitated, Speed0, no Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions). It has no corpse/soul/loot. The chamber’s independent correct-plate terminal may still pacify/disperse that same identity; no generic healing/repair is invented.

**Local actor bindings.** ACT-TOY-SENTINEL: ordinaryNonlivingConstruct; ACT-SILENCE-WRAITH: localSpirit; ACT-ACCORD-DEVIL: localProjection; ACT-ACCORD-DEMON: localProjection; ACT-ECHO-DOPPELGANGER: localProjection; ACT-FEAST-STEWARD: explicit Collapsed Projection actor rule; ACT-NULL-WITNESS: ordinaryLiving; ACT-GLASS-MENDER-SENTINEL: localProjection.

**What Null Veil does not erase.** Does not remove old Wounds/Injuries, revive Dead creatures, clear existing dying counters, rewrite death history, cure conditions, or prevent non-damage lethal costs/tracks. Newly-zero stabilization resets only its current death-save counters because becoming Stable requires that under Core. Direct HP payments/sacrificial costs are not damage and are not converted. This nonlethal override does not alter Hunt finality or Hunted Death rules for actual later deaths from other causes.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Components, summons and ongoing effects

**V** requires audible speech; **S** requires a free hand or a class feature expressly permitting the gesture; **F** is the class's ordinary casting focus. Core's M/F shorthand is interpreted here as the existing focus alternative. No unspecified costly or consumed material is added. These hand/focus conventions are provisional and may require equipment integration. A spell with V is blocked by an effect explicitly preventing verbal casting.

Summon stat blocks use their printed AC/HP/attack die. Where absent, saves use the owner's PB, other ability checks use +0, walking Speed is 30 feet, and there are no unstated creature immunities or extraordinary senses. Unless a card explicitly gives another bounded range, a commanded companion must be within 60 feet and able to perceive its owner. All one owner's companions share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging action total per round**. Without a command they move and Dodge. A replacement requires the full casting cost. No summon grants loot, a reusable corpse or resource-generating death trigger.

The [rank-2 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK2_EXACT_REVIEW.md) approves this specific companion overlay: **when an exact companion source prints multiple attacks as one damaging action, those attacks are components of one commanded offensive action and consume the owner's single offensive-companion allowance unless that source expressly grants otherwise.** Summon Air Pet explicitly makes its two source attacks within that one action; no second command/action or remaining offense for another companion is created. Its fixed AC15/HP20/two 1d6 attacks do not inherit generic companion scaling.

Planar Ally (Minor) uses a finite NEW summon-only profile for the source's intended CR-1 role. The bounded public bestiary scan did not establish an eligible published exact-CR1 extraplanar creature; this card does not certify its CR or rewrite a bestiary entry. Summon Weaponry Satchel has finite conjured contents tied to one duration, with a narrow exception only for an already resolving immediate use. Alignment Weapon's suppression default applies only to that printed card.

Resonance Well rolls one 1d4 total reserve. Its separately named creation and receipt uses commit before prevention and reset only through each character's beneficial long rest. These limits neither share nor reset Kindle or Mod Rod records. Read the exact cards and [rank-2 status](CONJURATION_RANK2_REVIEW_STATUS.json); pricing/schema checks do not execute these effects or certify balance.

The [rank-3 Conjuration review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_RANK3_EXACT_REVIEW.md) adds seven bounded cards. Earth Pet's knockdown is Prone, not positional movement; generic push/pull immunity does not automatically prevent it. Burst of Flamewind affects every creature the caster ordinarily classifies as an enemy at a known location in its cone, with automatic source damage and a save controlling only its push.

Elemental Displacement selects a nearby willing recipient and a perceived destination; its teleport path is not constrained by intervening terrain. Spectral Steed actually crosses planes to a known site, once per steed attempt. Its 350-pound **and** 12-Load limits count the rider's body and all gear, including melded equipment. The reviewed correction from the conference's proposed6Load avoids excluding all gear from a Medium rider; ordinary Burdened applies at6Load. Read the exact mount/command/arrival procedure; it does not close general mounted combat.

Resonance Conduit transfers already-existing RP between two separate pools, with committed deductions, gated credit, and no resource creation or daily-ledger reset. Renewed consent cannot revive an ended application, but a new legal paid cast may create a new one. Faction Portal provides actual one-way travel to a known HQ on the same or another plane. Its positive-standing predicate uses the current canonical reputation record without migrating its scale. Travel may bypass a geographic route; elapsed clocks, cargo custody, contamination, claims, arrival law and settlement remain actual procedures. These cards do not declare automatic Extraction success or invent a blanket prohibition on planar escape. [Review status](CONJURATION_RANK3_REVIEW_STATUS.json) preserves the manuscript/runtime/balance distinction.

 Noncombat helpers cannot attack or operate combat items.

A cantrip that stabilizes restores no HP and removes no Wound. Mending cannot replace finite machine repair or refresh ammunition, charges, duration or class resources. Created tools, servants and water obey the explicit card limits; a spell does not silently pay wages, produce saleable materials or erase abstract expedition Supply.

All hard whole-Action/turn denial uses one combined **source-character/target/encounter** record across that character's spells, class features and companions. Once used, later hard-denial riders from that source fail; damage and soft riders resolve as printed. Boss immunities remain effective. Same-stat flat bonuses use the strongest; same-name dice bonuses do not stack. Apply one allowed bonus-die spell per roll in this packet unless a reviewed feature explicitly permits more. Temporary HP never add together. Copies never generate copies, class procs or resource loops.

completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Actual anatomy/placement changes
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
## Placement and involuntary endings

A transformation does not grant movement. A voluntary size change keeps the same spatial anchor and must fit before payment. Preserve the existing footprint on a same-size change when possible.

A mandatory ending still occurs if the root anatomy does not fit. First try its normal space at the same position, then a legal squeeze under the [movement rules](COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md). If neither fits, record a placement conflict. The **new provisional placement procedure** permits only a nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space. Choose the minimum displacement that fits the whole body; among ties, preserve the greatest overlap with its previous footprint. If still tied, the Director uses a fixed neutral board order, not a tactical choice by the affected player. If no adjacent candidate fits, the conflict remains until the obstruction is removed or a legal relocation effect resolves it. Do not search farther afield.

This mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no opportunity attack, charge distance, movement benefit or other movement rider. It changes no remaining movement allowance and grants no invented crushing damage. It does not permit a voluntary form change to bypass its preflight.

Track actual height and terrain. Losing flight while unsupported starts ordinary falling from the current location; reversion never moves the creature directly to the ground. Ending a burrowing form underground does not move the creature to the surface. Master of Vermin's permission to pass through Tiny gaps changes clearance, not its printed size.

Use the actual space of the expressed anatomy:

| Size | Space | On a grid of 2.5-foot subcells |
|---|---|---|
| Tiny | 2.5 by 2.5 feet | 1 subcell |
| Small | 5 by 5 feet | 2 by 2 subcells |
| Medium | 5 by 5 feet | 2 by 2 subcells |
| Large | 10 by 10 feet | 4 by 4 subcells |

V6 explicitly supplies Tiny and Medium space. Small and Large complete this bounded table provisionally; the supplied V6 passage does not separately list them. Size category still matters even when two sizes occupy the same space. Squeezing changes clearance and its penalties; it does not change size, carrying capacity or weight. Exact Tiny occupancy requires subcells or equivalent measurement, not treating Tiny as Medium.

completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Exactly the named condition
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority: ## Prone **Preserved Core text:** Crawl or stand; melee attackers within 5 ft. have advantage; ranged attackers have disadvantage. **Effect:** Own attacks have disadvantage. Melee attacks against it within 5 feet have advantage; ranged attacks against it have disadvantage at every distance; other attacks beyond 5 feet have disadvantage. Movement requires crawling or standing. Drop Prone without Speed expenditure; standing costs half current Speed, rounded down, requires nonzero Speed and sufficient movement. Crawl costs 2 feet per foot, or 3 in difficult terrain. **Application:** Applied when an effect explicitly knocks a creature Prone or another rule such as Unconscious causes it. **Duration and ending:** Ends when the creature successfully stands or an explicit effect ends Prone. **Stacking:** Does not stack. **Immunities and specific exceptions:** Prone immunity blocks application. A feature may explicitly ignore Prone attack penalties. **Compatible V6/source details:** - V6: only movement is crawl unless standing; own attack rolls have disadvantage; attacks from within 5 feet have advantage, otherwise disadvantage. **Source conflicts:** - For a ranged attack made from within 5 feet, V6 distance-only wording would grant advantage while Core specifically says ranged attackers have disadvantage. Core controls. **Explicit integration decisions:** - Core-vs-V6 conflict resolved in favor of Core for ranged attacks within 5 feet. - Recovered V6 movement: half-Speed standing and 2/3-for-1 crawling. NEW explicit zero-Speed standing prohibition, preventing zero-cost standing while Grappled. Provenance: Core V2 `books/player/Decennium_Descent_Core_Systems_Bible_v2_Known_Descent.docx`, zero-based all-XML heading paragraph 763, definition paragraph 764; both positions, exact text and book SHA-256 are verified against the approved book and retained in the [condition data](../../data/playtest/condition_playtests.json).

completeEntryUnchanged.name: Dimensional Anchor
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only Dimensional Anchor
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: create a fixed 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range and line of effect, with concentration up to one minute. It prevents an actual teleportation or planar-transition transaction when any transported body’s origin or destination footprint intersects the area. Cargo travels with its actual body; an object transported independently uses its own endpoints. Do not test an imaginary path between two outside endpoints. Ordinary travel through the area remains possible. The rule applies to willing, hostile and self transport using established location records; it creates no destination or plane. A portal can remain present, but transit using a blocked endpoint cannot complete. A known obstruction fails preflight before payment; hidden obstruction or a field established after commitment can defeat a paid transit, leaving the entire transaction at its origin. Atomic group travel fails together, without splitting bodies or inventory. Ending or suppressing the field allows future otherwise legal transactions but does not retry or refund past attempts. The field does not suppress summons, images, mundane movement, physical forced displacement, spells generally, or effects merely because they once crossed space. There is no save or physical cage. An explicit source exception can bypass only the prevention it actually names.

exactAuthority.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: Antimagic Field (Lesser)
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only Antimagic Field (Lesser)
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
Action; range 10 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP. Preserve the source's 10-foot sphere and suppression promise. NEW: choose one perceived fixed point within 10 feet and line of effect; create a fixed 10-foot-radius sphere with concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, explicitly replacing the source's insufficient Instantaneous field duration for this authored procedure. The volume is clipped by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center and never follows a creature.

The field suppresses the local expression of actual ongoing spells and explicitly magical nonspell technique expressions only where their real body/effect/anchor intersects the operative volume. It supplies no rank ceiling. It does not retroactively undo completed damage, healing, movement, transmutation, consumed items, permanent ordinary matter, HP loss or source history. It does not erase class engines, learned facts, RP pools, injuries or intrinsic nonmagical traits. A magic item keeps its mundane body/ownership/contents while its magical enhancements/actions are unavailable. A creature-attached spell buff is wholly unavailable while the creature intersects; a large wall/field loses only its intersecting portion unless its own indivisible source says otherwise.

An otherwise legal spell cast may still be committed inside: pay its real final price, Action/components/cadence and concentration transition. If the spell's relevant manifestation originates inside the field, suppress that payload at resolution; there is no queued later release and no refund. Do not invent an imaginary straight-line beam/path for teleportation or nonprojectile magic. For current Dimensional Door, an origin and endpoint both outside the field are unaffected even if a drawn line crosses it; an origin actually inside the field has its spell payload suppressed after legal commitment. A remote ongoing effect outside is not canceled merely because its concentrating caster enters the field.

Ranger Nature's Whisper is an explicitly magical NONSPELL technique. Inside the field its Action+1 RP+Recharge 3 commitment remains a nonspell event; the magical payload/rider is unavailable with no rank, Counterspell window or Nexus/Dampening price. A still-live Nature's Whisper rider on an actor inside the field is unusable while suppressed but its clock continues.

Oracle's Burden prevents generic remove/suspend of the intrinsic Oracle Curse, so this field does not erase or suspend the Curse engine. Curse Manifestation, Tongues and Consumed retain only their own exact suppression/appearance permissions and timers.

Instances of Lesser Antimagic do not suppress one another; overlapping instances form the union of active volumes. This same-family exception only prevents oscillation and grants no ability to cast a new field from inside another without paying/satisfying the new cast, whose payload is itself exempt only because it is this family.

For Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. For accepted ordinary Banishment, only actual suppression of the application itself invokes its own accepted closure/end rule; merely suppressing its distant caster does not reach the generated cell/application. For Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment, AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 expressly gives the same close-on-actual-suppression behavior.

Suppression never pauses absolute/source clocks and does not bank missed attacks, aura starts, periodic damage, saves or commands. On exit/end, only still-live source expressions resume with the same remaining HP/pools/deadlines. Wall of Force uses its own safe segment-resumption rule.

Repair04 incoming/output completion: use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04. An instantaneous effect cast outside is not immune merely because its source is outside: inspect the actual recipient/area/destination manifestation. Local damage/healing inside is suppressed with no packet/root; an outside-origin Dimensional Door whose destination footprint is inside fails atomically after cost, while outside→outside remains unaffected regardless of an imaginary line. A legal Greater Dispel or exact class Dispel resolves captured termination operations under AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04; the target Antimagic application ignores only its own suppression, while a different Antimagic field can still suppress that termination operation; ordinary Counterspell remains only a cast-time response before the field exists. Spell Preservation’s primary-book anti-destruction remains source-intrinsic even while magical book usability is suppressed.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: Greater Dispel
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Only Greater Dispel
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
Action; casting-point range 30 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; Instantaneous. Choose one perceived center within 30 feet. At resolution take one immutable snapshot of every ongoing independently addressable magical effect application having an affected body, discrete anchor/object effect, or freestanding area portion inside the 30-foot-radius sphere and center line of effect. Allies are included. Individual effect perception is not required; no numerical cap or selective post-result omission exists.

Eligible ordinary spell applications retain their original generating rank. Rank 0-5 ends automatically. Rank 6-9 requires one check per original generating cast using the caster's actual spellcasting ability + PB against DC 10 + 2×recorded rank. Reuse that one roll for all captured applications from the same generating cast. Apply current Core task degrees/natural shifts. A nonspell magical component is eligible only if its own source explicitly supplies a dispel interface/rank/DC; never assign rank 0 by appearance or RP cost.

Capture is fixed before any endings. If a captured Wall of Force ends and reveals another effect behind it, that effect is not added. A captured indivisible wall/field ends as one effect on successful/automatic dispel; recipient-specific applications from one cast end only where captured unless their real parent dependency says ending one ends all. Suppressed-but-still-existing records can be dispelled if this cast itself can reach them. Completed instantaneous consequences, permanent matter, class engines, permanent item enchantments and explicitly nondispellable effects are outside scope.

This is distinct from Wizard class Dispel Magic `/cards/19`: that class spell costs 3 RP, range 60, Recharge 2, auto through rank 3, and uses INT+PB vs DC 10+rank above 3. Sigil Authority `/cards/22` names Counterspell and Dispel Magic only and does not modify Greater Dispel. Xi remains its own consent-based branch-ending source and grants no Greater Dispel permission.

exactAuthority.classification: NEW narrowly scoped temporary Banishment spell-space; names no canonical plane
exactAuthority.planeIdentity: A distinct temporary extraplanar spell-cell generated by this spell. It is not identified with any named reviewed plane, afterlife, deity, Heartcell state, soul destination, natural origin or campaign era.
exactAuthority.coordinates: Cell-local x=east, y=north, z=up. Floor is z=0. The primary arrives with the center of its horizontal footprint at local (0,0) in its current orientation.
exactAuthority.initialGeometry: Initial horizontal extent equals the primary's actual footprint plus 5 feet of clearance on every side; round each total horizontal axis upward to the next 5 feet. Height equals actual occupied body height plus 5 feet overhead, rounded upward to the next 5 feet. Example: Medium 5x5 body with occupied height 6 feet starts in x[-7.5,+7.5], y[-7.5,+7.5], z[0,15]. A Tiny 2.5x2.5 body also receives a 15x15 horizontal cell after rounding.
exactAuthority.supportAndEnvironment: The entire current cell floor is level ephemeral support. The cell supplies ordinary light and a nonharmful spell-local sustaining medium sufficient for an admitted body's already-established respiration needs. This grants no stock, harvest, resistance, immunity, amphibious trait or cosmological fact.
exactAuthority.boundaries: Cell boundaries are opaque to mundane sight/sound and ordinary line of effect/passage. A source cannot target space beyond the current boundary and rely on later expansion to make that target legal.
exactAuthority.voluntaryGeometry: Voluntary body-size/shape changes follow their actual source and BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md preflight against the current in-cell volume. Banishment does not expand first to legalize a voluntary change.
exactAuthority.mandatoryGeometry: An actual mandatory ending/reversion/death/body-lifecycle event is never failed, delayed or negated to preserve cell geometry. Resolve it first under its source. If the resulting current body needs more room, expand the cell outward after the mandatory event, only enough to contain all extant bodies plus 5 feet clearance. Expansion moves no body and creates no new target permission.
exactAuthority.materiality: Floor/walls/light/sustaining medium are ephemeral spell boundaries with no inventory identity, sale, harvest or residue.

completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Ordinary Banishment; only AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 extends its named portions

exactAuthority.classification: NEW Banishment-only finite ending. The spell-cell ends; physical fit is then handed to the accepted canonical BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST placement-conflict procedure rather than protected closure anchors.
exactAuthority.trigger: Every Banishment application ending invokes closure: deadline, concentration end, valid Xi/end/suppression, or primary legal escape. Invoke even for an empty cell; an empty ephemeral cell simply ceases.
exactAuthority.originPlane: At successful establishment snapshot the primary target's actual origin-plane identity as an opaque existing plane reference and its fixed world anchor/orientation. The anchor never rides with a later-moving platform/vehicle. This records location only and does not name or settle cosmology.
exactAuthority.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. This creates metadata only: no origin-plane space is reserved, protected, excluded or altered.
exactAuthority.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. For each genuinely loose surviving object, project its current cell-local position onto the primary fixed world anchor to obtain an item placement anchor. Consumed/destroyed/escaped objects are absent.
exactAuthority.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
exactAuthority.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. Do not ignore physical terrain, occupancy, anatomy, support, death/body removal, item existence or any voluntary-travel rule. This exception grants no future transport privilege and cannot be used for escape or another spell.
creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
exactAuthority.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space and does not search farther afield.
exactAuthority.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. If that leaves a later entity with no same-anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent candidate, the later entity records a placement conflict; earlier legal placements are not undone.
exactAuthority.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. Preserve the same extant identity on the snapshotted origin plane with placementConflict=true and a fixed closureAnchorReference. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. The closureAnchorReference is the creature's logical spatial location for measuring range and evaluating source predicates while no legal occupied footprint exists. Do not grant movement, adjacency, occupancy, cover, squeezing, wall passage, overlap, flanking, support contact or other footprint-dependent benefits merely from that reference. Perception and line of effect are evaluated from the closureAnchorReference through the actual current terrain using the exact source's normal rules; solid barriers can therefore block them. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
exactAuthority.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
exactAuthority.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
exactAuthority.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
exactAuthority.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

completeEntryUnchanged.name: Meteor Spear exact mixed-defense allocation
completeEntryUnchanged.scope: Meteor Spear and only its actually authorized same-packet descendants. Not Ice Storm or a global defense-stacking rule. Historical staging labels in full model are superseded only by the actual exact receipt.
completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
NEW DC25-MIXED-DEFENSE-02, proposed ONLY for Meteor Spear and an actually authorized descendant of that same damage packet. This allocates an already applicable aggregate flat reduction; it does not grant one, move its source stage, copy it onto every component, or rerun mitigation on a post-defense transfer where accepted sharing disallows that mitigation.

After the spell's separate fire/bludgeoning save rounding, select applicable defenses under their actual sources. For competing class flat reductions covered by CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES use one strongest flat amount, not one before-resistance amount plus another after-resistance amount. Spinal Plating's explicit after-resistance wording changes the stage of that selected source, not the number of reductions granted. If an accepted source independently permits a separate stage, retain only that express permission. NEW Meteor-only equal-amount tie completion: when no more specific source chooses between equal competing flat reductions, choose the lexically first stable source-mechanical-ID and then application-ID, fixed before any resistance/immune outcome; this is not a player optimization or a global stacking rule. A larger ordinary class reduction therefore wins over a smaller Spinal Plating reduction; Spinal applies after resistance only when it is the selected applicable reduction. All real acquisition, active mutation, use and expiry prerequisites still apply.

At the selected aggregate stage, combine entries of the same canonical damage type. Let their nonnegative integer eligible amounts be a_i, A=sum(a_i), and B=min(applicable reduction,A). If A=0, allocate nothing. Otherwise assign each type floor(B*a_i/A); give the remaining integer points, one each, to the greatest exact fractional remainders, breaking ties by lexical canonical damage-type ID. Use exact rational arithmetic for this comparison. Zero-valued or ineligible components receive no share. No component becomes negative. Do not use a later resistance/immunity result to change the allocation.

Ordinary selected class flat reduction occurs before typed resistance/immunity. A selected Spinal Plating reduction occurs after typed resistance. Apply each type's actual immunity/resistance and its normal rounding exactly once at the authorized stage. Preserve typed residuals through actual prevention/transfer. Finish one grouped damage event per actual terminal recipient under Core/Null/lifecycle; no extra hit, Wound save, payment, resource trigger or replacement Null root is created by the component split. Other mixed-damage spells require their own express extension rather than inheriting this allocation by name.

completeEntryUnchanged.exactAuthority:
NEW P20-ICE-MIXED-07 — Ice Storm only. Preserve one simultaneous original-recipient damage event with bludgeoning and cold subamounts. Roll each printed 4d6 pool once for the cast. Apply the stated save factor to each type and floor each half separately. The following distribution rule grants no defense and changes no defense's eligibility, required activation, actual flat amount, frequency or explicitly stated before/after-resistance stage.

For competing flat damage reductions governed by CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md, select only the strongest applicable flat amount for this event, not one winner at each stage. An explicit after-resistance clause changes the selected source's stage; it does not independently authorize stacking with another competing class flat reduction. If equal amounts from different sources remain tied and no exact accepted priority decides them, NEW Ice-Storm-only tie completion: use ascending immutable source-card ID, then original owner ID and application ID. Freeze that selection before allocation and do not optimize it using later resistance, temporary HP, Wounds, or the player's preferred outcome. Independent barriers, explicit reductions outside that strongest-class-DR arbitration and real sharing operations retain their separate source permissions and stages; this rule neither creates them nor deletes them.

At the selected source's actual reduction stage, aggregate all currently eligible amounts of the same canonical damage type. Let B=min(the selected source's flat reduction, the sum of its eligible nonnegative typed amounts). Allocate B in exact rational proportion to those amounts. Give each type the floor of its share, then assign remaining integer points to the largest fractional remainders, with exact ties in ascending canonical damage-type ID. A zero amount receives no allocation. Splitting one type into dice or rows cannot change the result. Do not reduce any component below zero, apply a source's flat amount once per type, or select an allocation using later immunity/resistance. Use exact rationals or equivalent integer arithmetic, not floating-point tie guesses.

An ordinary selected class reduction resolves before resistance/immunity; then apply each actual typed defense and round under its source. A selected Spinal Plating or other exact after-resistance reduction acts on the amounts remaining after that stage instead. Retain surviving typed lineage through any actual later barrier, sharing or transfer. Resolve one grouped original-recipient temporary-HP/HP/Wound/zero event. Transfer recipients retain only their own actual lifecycle consequences and source flags. There is no extra cast, attack, save, Wound trigger, copied payment or fresh Null root merely because this packet contains two types. This rule is separately proposed for Ice Storm; the pending Meteor option is historical comparison, not its authority, and no other mixed-damage spell inherits it.

procedure.completeText:
Action; range60feet; V/S/F; Instantaneous. KEEP a line of enemies and8d6 fire PLUS3d6 bludgeoning. NEW choose a straight direction from a real point on the caster’s occupied boundary; the finite rectangular prism is sixty feet long, five feet wide and five feet high, with its cross-section centered on the declared axis. Orient the axis legally in three dimensions; the origin alone does not include the caster. Affect all currently perceived creatures affirmatively designated hostile that intersect the prism with origin line of effect; no chosen target cap, hidden-allegiance test or selective post-roll omission. Allies not designated hostile are excluded by the source enemy clause. Each selected creature makes DEX. NEW failure takes both full typed amounts; success takes half of each separately, rounded down. Roll8d6 fire once and3d6 bludgeoning once for the whole line. Apply source/type-specific defenses and source-preserving damage sharing before a single simultaneous original-recipient damage event and its actual callbacks. The line stops applying through actual barriers/total cover and never bores a tunnel. Destruction by a genuinely separate effect follows its real timing; this cast does not recalculate additional targets exposed during its own event. Impale describes only these printed damage components: no pin, forced movement, Grappled, Bleed, automatic Wound, lingering embedded object or reusable ammunition. No objects, carried gear, building structure or ground become spell damage recipients. After resolving the initial snapshot there is no line hazard, later entry effect or concentration.

NEW DC25-MIXED-DEFENSE-02, proposed ONLY for Meteor Spear and an actually authorized descendant of that same damage packet. This allocates an already applicable aggregate flat reduction; it does not grant one, move its source stage, copy it onto every component, or rerun mitigation on a post-defense transfer where accepted sharing disallows that mitigation.

After the spell's separate fire/bludgeoning save rounding, select applicable defenses under their actual sources. For competing class flat reductions covered by CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES use one strongest flat amount, not one before-resistance amount plus another after-resistance amount. Spinal Plating's explicit after-resistance wording changes the stage of that selected source, not the number of reductions granted. If an accepted source independently permits a separate stage, retain only that express permission. NEW Meteor-only equal-amount tie completion: when no more specific source chooses between equal competing flat reductions, choose the lexically first stable source-mechanical-ID and then application-ID, fixed before any resistance/immune outcome; this is not a player optimization or a global stacking rule. A larger ordinary class reduction therefore wins over a smaller Spinal Plating reduction; Spinal applies after resistance only when it is the selected applicable reduction. All real acquisition, active mutation, use and expiry prerequisites still apply.

At the selected aggregate stage, combine entries of the same canonical damage type. Let their nonnegative integer eligible amounts be a_i, A=sum(a_i), and B=min(applicable reduction,A). If A=0, allocate nothing. Otherwise assign each type floor(B*a_i/A); give the remaining integer points, one each, to the greatest exact fractional remainders, breaking ties by lexical canonical damage-type ID. Use exact rational arithmetic for this comparison. Zero-valued or ineligible components receive no share. No component becomes negative. Do not use a later resistance/immunity result to change the allocation.

Ordinary selected class flat reduction occurs before typed resistance/immunity. A selected Spinal Plating reduction occurs after typed resistance. Apply each type's actual immunity/resistance and its normal rounding exactly once at the authorized stage. Preserve typed residuals through actual prevention/transfer. Finish one grouped damage event per actual terminal recipient under Core/Null/lifecycle; no extra hit, Wound save, payment, resource trigger or replacement Null root is created by the component split. Other mixed-damage spells require their own express extension rather than inheriting this allocation by name.

originalSharedProposalUnchanged.damage: Roll each stated area damage type once per simultaneous pulse, then apply each recipient’s own save and defenses. originalSharedProposalUnchanged.geometryAndSelection: NEW explicit finite geometry is specified below. Use genuine occupied bodies, three-dimensional distance, actual cover and line of effect from the stated origin/center. Snapshot each event’s eligible recipients and geometry before resolving it; cover destroyed by another simultaneous result does not add recipients. A named creature target requires actual perception at commitment and resolution. Ordinary indiscriminate areas can affect unperceived bodies actually inside them. For the three source clauses explicitly naming enemies, NEW interpretation: use all creatures currently perceived by the caster and affirmatively treated as hostile from the caster’s available information, within the geometry at that pulse. No arbitrary numerical cap or post-roll omission is permitted. This is intent/information-based selection, not detection of actual allegiance: a deceiving enemy believed friendly may be missed, and a mistakenly designated innocent may be affected. Caster-origin enemy effects exclude the caster. This narrower perception requirement is expressly proposed for joint review, not silently added to the original summaries.

Already-underway target turns are excluded from future-turn counts.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.ongoingOwnership: NEW one active field of each field identity per caster; a successful new field replaces that caster’s old field only. Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP immediate 4d6 bludgeoning PLUS 4d6 cold and difficult terrain. NEW choose a perceived supported surface point with line of effect; create a fixed cylinder of twenty-foot radius and forty-foot height upward from that point, clipped by actual obstruction from the origin. The immediate hail affects all creatures in that region; no general object/roof destruction. Each makes one DEX save. Roll one shared 4d6 bludgeoning and one shared 4d6 cold; failure receives both full typed subamounts, success floors half of each separately. Apply type-specific defenses and combine the surviving typed components as one simultaneous damage event per original recipient. This is not two saves, two hits or two automatically duplicated Wound/concentration triggers; actual damage-sharing preserves type and the one original-recipient root. NEW residual terrain completion: after the instantaneous hail, retain a magical difficult-terrain footprint on genuinely exposed walkable surfaces within the affected cylinder for sixty elapsed seconds, without concentration. The source’s Instantaneous cast metadata is preserved as history; this expressly created rank-4 residual is ongoing and can be removed/suppressed by an actually qualifying effect. Ground movement cost doubles under normal terrain arbitration; overlapping same-cost terrain never quadruples it. There is no continuing hail damage, slip save, Prone, Frozen, cold vulnerability, obscuration or structural support. A source’s suppressed region has no terrain cost while its deadline runs. Clearing ordinary debris does not remove this magical field; actual dispel/removal can end it within its real area/source scope. At expiry or removal its transient hail/ice leaves no inventory or useful water, while independent physical changes already caused by legitimate other events remain. NEW one residual footprint per caster from this spell: a later successful resolution replaces that caster’s prior residual only, and never reverses earlier hail damage; a countered cast leaves the old nonconcentration footprint. Different casters retain separate fields and clocks.

NEW P20-ICE-MIXED-07 — Ice Storm only. Preserve one simultaneous original-recipient damage event with bludgeoning and cold subamounts. Roll each printed 4d6 pool once for the cast. Apply the stated save factor to each type and floor each half separately. The following distribution rule grants no defense and changes no defense's eligibility, required activation, actual flat amount, frequency or explicitly stated before/after-resistance stage.

For competing flat damage reductions governed by CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md, select only the strongest applicable flat amount for this event, not one winner at each stage. An explicit after-resistance clause changes the selected source's stage; it does not independently authorize stacking with another competing class flat reduction. If equal amounts from different sources remain tied and no exact accepted priority decides them, NEW Ice-Storm-only tie completion: use ascending immutable source-card ID, then original owner ID and application ID. Freeze that selection before allocation and do not optimize it using later resistance, temporary HP, Wounds, or the player's preferred outcome. Independent barriers, explicit reductions outside that strongest-class-DR arbitration and real sharing operations retain their separate source permissions and stages; this rule neither creates them nor deletes them.

At the selected source's actual reduction stage, aggregate all currently eligible amounts of the same canonical damage type. Let B=min(the selected source's flat reduction, the sum of its eligible nonnegative typed amounts). Allocate B in exact rational proportion to those amounts. Give each type the floor of its share, then assign remaining integer points to the largest fractional remainders, with exact ties in ascending canonical damage-type ID. A zero amount receives no allocation. Splitting one type into dice or rows cannot change the result. Do not reduce any component below zero, apply a source's flat amount once per type, or select an allocation using later immunity/resistance. Use exact rationals or equivalent integer arithmetic, not floating-point tie guesses.

An ordinary selected class reduction resolves before resistance/immunity; then apply each actual typed defense and round under its source. A selected Spinal Plating or other exact after-resistance reduction acts on the amounts remaining after that stage instead. Retain surviving typed lineage through any actual later barrier, sharing or transfer. Resolve one grouped original-recipient temporary-HP/HP/Wound/zero event. Transfer recipients retain only their own actual lifecycle consequences and source flags. There is no extra cast, attack, save, Wound trigger, copied payment or fresh Null root merely because this packet contains two types. This rule is separately proposed for Ice Storm; the pending Meteor option is historical comparison, not its authority, and no other mixed-damage spell inherits it.

At END, due damage/eligible ending saves precede that source endpoint cleanup, except a card explicitly expires before its redundant last save. Suppression consumes a due scheduled opportunity with no damage or catch-up. Ended creature identities have no recipient; administrative deadline bookkeeping never resurrects one.
completeSharedRules.P20-ATTACHED-PHASE-01: NEW source-specific bridge for the target-clock proposals in this cohort, not a general companion turn: an owner-attached recipient uses the original owner regular attached-phase beginning/end only for the stated spell packet or ending save. A future phase excludes one already underway. If no such real phase exists, retain a six-second spell-only checkpoint and finite original endpoint. This checkpoint supplies only a due packet/save or expiry that the spell actually grants; it supplies no Action, movement, Bonus Action, Reaction refresh, recharge, or ordinary death save. Source-required real Action/command maintenance cannot execute at an administrative checkpoint. Root identity, prior spent exposures, endpoint and finite tick count survive controller or schedule changes.
completeSharedRules.P20-FAMILY-EXPOSURE-01: NEW per-source anti-duplication applies only where the individual procedure names a family cap: record target identity, named spell family, explicit category and numbered round. Different owners/casts share that named ledger; distinct spell names and explicitly separate Wall of Fire categories do not merge. Outside initiative use the scene continuing six-second exposure cycle, fixed before the relevant exposure. Preserve its spent state through a transition to the current combat round until that mapped interval ends; never refresh just by changing timing mode. Immunity/save/prevention after actual admission still consumes the exposure; wholly suppressed or geometrically ineligible sources cannot claim it. Simultaneous eligible sources use established application order then stable identity. Immolation instead uses the already accepted ongoing-fire arbitration at each identical target marker.
completeSharedRules.P20-DAMAGE-FUNDING-01: Reuse actual typed defenses, temporary HP, HP floors, Wounds, concentration, death/Null life order and one original recipient event. No inferred damage amount from structural failure or overkill. ActualDamageDealt remains real tempHP absorption plus normal HP loss. Healing/funding is a separate consumer: first exclude any terminal branch whose actual transfer/source flag forbids derived healing or recovery, then apply the spell-specific donor predicate, sum eligible branches once and floor the half once. Never count a split parent again. Burden Shared and Life Linked restrictions remain operative; a numeric branch amount alone is not funding permission. Preserve the distinct pending Leeching Plague donor exclusions and Enervation wider proposal for explicit Director disposition.
completeSharedRules.P20-RNG-INFORMATION-01: Authored dice are engine RNG. Original component identity, draw method, save factor and cached ordinal value remain private engine state unless an actual separately accepted presentation policy grants the exact disclosure. This candidate grants no new public dice viewer, hidden-target list, successful-save feedback, enemy-identity scan or Fate eligibility. Shared damage dice do not merge recipient roots. The accepted exact DE4 five-entry presentation policy applies only where its actual source predicates pass; it does not automatically disclose any private periodic, delayed, penalty or random-selection operation in this cohort. An actual qualifying OVERT-ATTACK d20 can use that entry without exposing a hidden Synaptic Static d6, hidden modifier cause or later damage pool. No sixth presentation entry is proposed here. No RNG seed or future draw is exposed. If a source has no admitted recipient and no explicit source-authored event-generation rule, do not invent a damage event merely to publish a roll.
completeSharedRules.P20-ROOT-01: Every damage source uses its explicit pending per-source mapping in damageRootProposals. These are NEW decisions requiring concurrence; accepted Forbiddance/Chain Arc/Skybrand and lower nightmare rules do not silently generalize. Root creation alone spends no Action, deals no damage, triggers no Wound, generates no material, and grants no hidden information. Pure transfer retains flags; an attached component can retain an old flag while a genuinely new operated attack creates its own root. Physical fire and Sonic debris mappings are bounded to the exact finite proposed outputs.
completeSharedRules.P20-SUPPRESSION-01: Reuse the exact actual suppressor/removal source. Lesser Antimagic, rank limits and source versus expression tests keep their accepted scope. AC6 Globe is not general antimagic: its fixed boundary blocks only its actual incoming rank-0–5 source cases, does not ban all internal casting, and does not erase an already attached buff merely because a creature enters. A fixed external ongoing field and a target-attached rider have different origin facts. A spell object is not a creature; physical Inferno fuel/rubble after actual creation is not a sustained magical field. No suppression pauses a deadline or restores a destroyed body, cleared crystal patch, spent shot or old command.

sourceConflict.catalog: Rulebook catalog says only: Send a creature to another plane temporarily; catalog duration unspecified.
sourceConflict.core: Core entry supplies Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, 7 RP and duration Instantaneous.
sourceConflict.disposition: Preserve both original records unchanged. For provisional runnability, author NEW concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds while retaining Instantaneous as historical/source metadata. This is an explicit authored reconciliation, not a rewrite of either source.

questionDispositions.reason: A generated isolated extraplanar spell-cell preserves the printed temporary-other-plane effect without naming or identifying any reviewed plane. The draft topology is retained only as a local spell-space and revised to an elastic finite enclosure so body/atomic geometry changes do not require a hidden preemptive interrupt.

Use Action/60 ft/V-S-F/base 7 RP and actual class spell DC; NEW CHA save, willing pre-roll failure, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, one-live-application guard, and the existing shared hard-control allowance. Concentration begins at legal cast commitment and a failed/countered cast does not restore displaced concentration.

Use finite BAN-CLOSE-03. No pre-change early-return interrupt exists. Mandatory source events resolve normally. When Banishment ends, remaining identities are moved to the snapshotted origin plane despite a narrow terminal endpoint-blocker exception, then physical fitting is resolved by the already accepted canonical placement procedure. An unresolved physical placement conflict is an origin-plane state, not continuing exile.

Independently legal visitors and internally created creatures retain their own real permissions/costs. Their source must target a currently fitting, perceived in-cell footprint; Banishment cannot expand first to create target legality. At closure, all remaining real identities are returned once in stable order and handed to canonical placement; ended/escaped/consumed identities are not recreated.

The spell transports exactly the selected creature plus genuine noncreature worn/carried gear. Separate creature bodies—including passengers, mounts, swallowed creatures and companions—do not become gear. Impossible separation/tethers can defeat establishment. Transformations, death, body removal, Null Disabled summons and cargo keep their own source lifecycles.

Use accepted AC4 interfaces: rank-4 Banishment is ineligible for Spell Shield; Dimensional Anchor blocks ordinary planar endpoints; Resonance Beacon remains same-plane; Xi can end only the actual ongoing target branch with its exact consent/perception/range/charge procedure. Cleric Banish Unholy remains a different class technique.

Keep Paladin cards exact. NEW BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 classifies this spell only as planar/extradimensional displacement, not teleportation. No Escape blocks only voluntarily accepted Banishment because it expressly includes voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute does not block Banishment because it names only teleportation/invisibility; Reign of Ashes does not block because it denies benefit from Dash/teleportation. A pre-save acceptance flag determines voluntary versus forced admission whether the target elects failure or rolls.

BAN-ADMIT-03 allows a visitor/created body only through its own real destination/creation permission, cost and a fitting currently perceived in-cell footprint. No expansion can supply prior target perception/LoE. After legal establishment the cell may expand only for clearance. Admission grants no route, knowledge, immunity or return resource.

No universal interrupt or rewind is created. Mandatory transformations/death/expiry complete under their actual source. Cell geometry expands after mandatory in-cell anatomy changes as needed. Final Banishment ending uses BAN-CLOSE-03 and canonical placement-conflict handling on the origin plane; no future ruling is needed for ordinary collapse/filled-space cases.

Accepted AC4 procedures are interoperability authority only within their recorded scope; lexical class hits are navigation evidence only. Preserve all historical scenario text as evidence, author current adjudications separately, and claim no runtime/human/balance approval.
