AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

completeAcceptedCounterparts.qualification: Current acceptance receipt/index controls preserved historical candidate labels. This comparison grants no new source scope.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: All six retain native rank8/21RP, real classes and minimum level15. Catalog casting fields are unspecified; preserved Core rows supply Action and V/S/F, with Soul Pyre V/S/M/F.
questions.options: A: explicitly use the actual Core casting metadata where compatible, resolving each concrete conflict below. B: supply a reasoned native replacement and retain the original metadata as evidence.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A within exact scope. No free ordinary repertoire, generic class access or guessed priced component follows. Specify whether Soul Pyre requires the actual corpse as a separate nonreplaceable target/consumable despite focus substitution for other material components. Ordinary class ability, exact acquisition, price adjustments, Dissonance/Refrain, V/S/real focus, commitment and counter sequence remain unchanged. Source metadata is evidence, not a claim that missing payload procedure already exists.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source says 10d8 fire/piercing; no explicit typed division, save, number of targets or separate pools.
questions.options: A: choose one type at commitment, preserving one10d8 pool. B: explicitly partition one10d8 total into fixed fire/piercing pools. C: explicitly justify two full pools as a new change, rather than silently reading20d8.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Request a definite source-faithful allocation and one attack/save procedure. Meteor Spear prints two separate pools and Destructive Wave was expressly completed as one selected type; neither decides this slash notation globally. If two types are adopted, specify save rounding per type and expressly select a scoped mixed-defense allocation, including equal-source tie rules. The accepted Meteor and Ice Storm tie keys differ; preserve them and choose this spell independently. One original-recipient damage event must not become two automatic Wound/Null/concentration events.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Erupting lava spike FROM BELOW; Core Action120Instantaneous. Neither an area footprint nor target-ground relationship is printed.
questions.options: A: a single perceived creature and a precisely specified supported ground-origin line. B: a bounded eruption area with exact physical surface/height and recipient rules.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose. Preserve the upward eruption identity while specifying actual ground/ceiling/ship/platform, depth, air gaps, water and body intersections. Distinguish caster-to-origin line of effect from origin-to-recipient obstruction and preflight-known failures from late paid failures. Do not invent floor penetration, remote targeting through walls or an automatic airborne exclusion without an explicit decision. Range120 is not itself an area radius or damage height.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Lava/spike language supplies no lasting terrain, physical object profile, ignition, forced movement or source duration beyond Instantaneous.
questions.options: A: transient manifestation performing the stated packet only. B: real residual matter/terrain with complete new size, lifetime and interaction rules.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A unless the intended game behavior requires B. State whether objects/structures are legal recipients; structural damage cannot be inferred from the name. No silent tunnel, harvestable stone/lava, impalement restraint, ignition, second fall packet or ongoing burning. If residue is chosen, define support/collision, movement cost, cleanup, suppression and permanently changed independent objects without free repair or matter duplication.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Target takes10d6force as body partially dissolves; Core Action120Instantaneous, resolution unspecified.
questions.options: A: one eligible creature, explicit save/attack and one10d6force event. B: include objects or a separate body-alteration rider through new complete source rules.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with a precise target predicate and success result. Preserve10d6 and actual force defenses. Decide whether nonliving creatures, finite summons and transformed bodies qualify using real life/body categories, not labels or pictures. Separate attack/save targeting from later Core Wound/Instant Death and source-specific Null consequences. The word molecular grants neither immunity bypass nor knowledge of hidden anatomy.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Partial dissolving does not state instant death, disintegration of remains, equipment loss, a missing limb or reconstruction prohibition.
questions.options: A: damage presentation with only independently earned Core consequences. B: an explicit additional anatomy/remains procedure with complete eligibility and cleanup.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Ordinary0HP does not imply death or corpse erasure; actual death replacements and recipient-specific life layers resolve normally. Preserve same-body identity, gear custody, missing-part history and legitimate surviving remains. Disintegrate is still pending in the separate body-defense conference and supplies no accepted authority. Do not infer resurrection denial, Wound cure or creation of a new body from the animation.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Burn A CORPSE to explode; actual source does not specify eligible corpse type, age, minimum portion, ownership or death eligibility.
questions.options: A: source-specific eligibility on the existing one-body/corpse record. B: any object described as dead, including fabricated fragments or created minions.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. State exact corpse/body availability and retained origin requirements, required quantity/integrity, size, age and optional type restrictions as new decisions where needed. Living0HP bodies are not corpses. Ranger surviving corpses, consumed standard undead bodies, destroyed finite summons, fragments, temporary forms and genuine reconstructed bodies require their actual identities; do not grant a universal humanoid-only or necromancy-only rule by analogy. Existing body lifecycle records prevent duplicate claims but do not by themselves authorize this spell to consume a particular corpse.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core20feet conflicts with potential caster-to-corpse range versus the printed20foot blast; corpse consumption timing is absent.
questions.options: A: explicitly separate corpse selection range and a20foot radius centered on that real corpse. B: another fully stated geometry justified by the source.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with exact3D body-origin point/volume and obstruction. Choose when corpse is exclusively reserved, when consumption commits and whether countering or late ineligibility leaves an unconsumed body. Use one actual resource transaction across competing raise, corpse transport, other Pyre and lawful resurrection; no refund/duplication or favorable after-the-fact corpse substitution. Resolve a corpse moved before the blast and already committed simultaneous operations with an exact snapshot. This is a design choice, not a globally inferred consumed-material policy.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: 8d6 fire + necrotic has one printed dice expression and no split, save, selectivity or object damage rule.
questions.options: A: explicitly divide one8d6 total between the two printed types. B: explicitly choose a different justified interpretation; do not silently double to16d6 or drop one type.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a fixed stated split preserving both types and one original-recipient event. Specify save/failure/success and all-creature inclusion, including caster/allies in20feet. Mixed defenses need this spell’s express scope extension; neither Meteor nor Ice Storm authorizes it automatically. Define exact actual damage-sharing/temporaryHP/Core/Null lineage and whether inanimate objects qualify. Soul in the name grants no soul capture, reserve, RP recovery, corpse generation, healing or caster ownership of anyone’s soul.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Burning a corpse may consume body matter, but the source supplies no exact remains/gear/reconstruction state.
questions.options: A: explicit spent original-body identity with described surviving ashes/gear and no new fuel entitlement. B: a recoverable corpse with a separately specified one-use mark.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose the native physical result. Preserve lineage through ashes/fragments and competing legal recovery. A consumption flag is not permission to delete historical source/body records or carried inventory. State what independent resurrection/reconstruction sources would still have to supply; do not invent a new soul destination, irrecoverable metaphysical death or universal recovery prohibition. A later ordinary dispel cannot replay consumption or restore a paid corpse unless an exact chosen ongoing effect says so.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Printed10d8fire PER ROUND in20foot radius; Core says range20feet and Instantaneous.
questions.options: A: explicitly supply a finite ongoing cloud duration/concentration and separate placement range from20foot radius. B: consciously revise the repeated-damage promise; not an unnoticed Instantaneous default.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Preserve10d8 each genuinely authorized pulse, actual20foot radius, exact center/height/3D footprint, recipient filter and save outcome. Choose actual range rather than interpreting radius as both range and placement without discussion. Define concentration and deadline openly. No preset ten-round duration, enemy-only exclusion or additional cloud movement is sourced merely by a familiar external spell name.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Per-round damage leaves creation, turn-start/entry, attached companion phases, outside-initiative cadence and overlapping sources unspecified.
questions.options: A: expressly extend a selected accepted Persistent20 exposure/clock policy to this identity. B: a different fully specified native pulse policy.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A after choosing the exact useful pulse contract. Distinguish creation pulse from later pulses and prevent duplicate immediate/start/entry damage from bookkeeping artifacts. Specify source or recipient clock, repeated entry, forced entry, whole-body boundary overlap, large bodies, birth-round companions and missed exposure. Exposure claims and deadlines survive suppression, extra turns, owner disappearance and initiative transitions. Decide same-name different-owner arbitration explicitly; retained separate source records do not imply free stacking or discarded source identity.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Cloud implies no exact obscuration, gas behavior, wind, ignition, water cancellation, translation or material residue.
questions.options: A: bounded fixed magical fire field with only explicitly selected perception/physical traits. B: a moving/dissipating physical cloud with complete rules.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose complete behavior without importing an external spell. Define real blockers and origin-to-body line of effect, whether obscuration affects targeting, and whether smoke/breath or environmental consequences exist. If wind/water movement is added, define source, speed, per-source timing and continuity of exposure identity. End/suppress/restore follows the explicitly chosen source policy, never replays missed ticks, repairs actual damage or manufactures loot. Ordinary fire immunity differs from immunity to smoke or an independently authored condition.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: 8d10force PLUS banish1enemy; unstable gate does not state force target count/area or whether damage and banishment use the same recipient.
questions.options: A: one perceived enemy receives both components with explicit attack/save and ordering. B: a precisely bounded force area plus one selected banishment recipient.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose; do not erase either printed benefit or infer an area from gate. Preserve8d10 and define save(s), success damage, enemy designation and target snapshot. Decide force-before-exile versus exile-before-force and any gate requiring positive damage or failed same save. Damage immunity, transport prevention, hard-control denial, death or actual survival replacement must independently govern only the appropriate component. Damage redirected to another body does not automatically relocate that body.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Native banishment must name actual destination/lifetime/admission and return policy; accepted Banishment explicitly limits its temporary cell and transport clauses to named scopes.
questions.options: A: expressly extend specified accepted Banishment interfaces to this spell with stated deviations. B: define a different complete temporary transport/cell model.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A if it preserves intended behavior. Explicitly decide CHA or other save, voluntary/resisted admission, hard-removal allowance, live-application conflicts, concentration, maximum duration and cell ownership. Record exact source clauses extended; do not globally relabel displacement as teleport or silently bypass No Escape/anchors. The accepted cell is spell-local and establishes no named cosmological plane. Gate appearance alone grants no traversable portal, passengers, free plane selection or external summoning.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A paid damaging exile must reconcile temporary body/custody, suppression, closure and source termination with its original Instantaneous metadata.
questions.options: A: instantaneous damage plus a separately declared ongoing exile application. B: another complete explicit combination.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A if adopting a finite exile. Keep original/temporary body dimensions, carried creatures/gear, pending concentration and clocks; identify exact custody/visitor permissions rather than invent them. On genuine ending, use expressly extended closure/placement handoff, including occupied origin and mandatory body/life changes. No erased damage, restarted turn, return healing or orphaned cell. Countering before establishment leaves no effect but does not restore concentration displaced at commitment. State whether suppressing exile closes permanently or another explicitly chosen outcome.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A huge wall APPEARS TO COLLAPSE, causing8d6psychic and Prone. Core concentration up to1minute leaves one event versus repeated collapses unresolved.
questions.options: A: one damage/Prone event with a separately defined finite visual manifestation. B: an ongoing source with expressly limited later collapse triggers.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose and explain the concentration/one-minute role. Preserve8d6 and Prone, with explicit eligible recipients, geometry, save and separate success outcomes. A concentration marker is not permission for ten free attacks or repeated Prone after standing. Reentry, new observer, new target, extra turn, suppression and repeated cast must not create unprinted fresh triggers. Choose what happens if the visual is ended before its scheduled event.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No exact width/height/thickness, collapse direction, occupied-region test, perception gate or disbelieving procedure is printed.
questions.options: A: explicit illusory geometry and a narrowly defined perception/mental effect. B: an imposed psychic/balance effect whose image is presentation, with expressly chosen admission.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose the actual model, not a generic all-illusions rule. Describe caster placement within120, affected body region, total cover, who must perceive what and actual blindness/true perception/immunity branches. Accepted Invisible Tide is a specific nonvisual balance disruption; its True Seeing and blindness clauses do not automatically authorize this wall. Active Illusion14 has no final acceptance, so new detection/disbelief rules from that packet remain proposed. No physically real cover, platform, crushing mass, falling masonry or objects emerge without explicit native authorship.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Psychic damage and actual Prone may have independent protection, death and movement consequences.
questions.options: A: exact separate component admission after the stated save/damage sequence. B: a source-specific linked gate, explicitly justified.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A unless the selected illusion model requires B. Psychic immunity alone does not imply Prone immunity, but an exact source preventing the entire admitted effect still controls. State mindless/nonperceiving creatures using real traits, not invented creature-type immunity. Prone is the actual condition with real standing, swimming/flying/hover support and Falling timing, not a one-round stun or damage multiplier. Surviving0HP/death and would-die replacements resolve before new living-state riders. Neither a later dispel nor recognizing the visual rewinds completed damage or creates a free stand absent an explicit rule.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: All six interact with actual committed costs, temporaryHP/Wounds, damage sharing, real recipient life kinds, Null provenance, interruption and suppression.
questions.options: A: expressly inherit named accepted contracts within scope and add only local completions above. B: rewrite global damage, Core life, Null or class systems as a shortcut.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Every current case must retain real class ability/level/repertoire, actual final price and chronological history, complete target geometry/life state, saved RNG facts, actual packet subtypes/stages and source-owned outcomes. A source-specific Null root or transferred terminal branch is not a new original hit or a new capture/resource opportunity. Exact boundary failures distinguish no commitment from paid no-effect and partial legitimate outcomes. At its one legally commanded attached phase choose exactly one of two offensive Actions. Slam: one melee attack against an actually perceived target within 5 feet and LoE from the Golem's body, using original owner's current creating-class spell attack, dealing 2d10 bludgeoning with no ability add; attack critical uses 4d10. Slow Aura is the other offensive Action, not a free passive in addition to Slam. At activation declare the finite actual enemy identities selected from opposition known to that owner/body; this supplies no hidden hostility detector or new information. Ordinary zero-HP destruction, expiry, concentration ending, actual removal or full sustaining-expression suppression ends it and the source's remaining aura, without corpse/XP/loot/harvest. Qualifying Null instead leaves the same extant body NullDisabled0 while the source persists; no dying/Wound/Stable engine is added and no generic organic-healing repair is granted. Independent ending/suppression still removes that disabled body. Real external cargo settles at the current actual location under legal item placement; intrinsic appearance creates no material stock.

selectedSharedRules.wording:
SELECTED for these six ordinary spells only. Keep every complete native classAccess row: all six are rank 8, base 21 RP, minimum listed class level 15; an actual acquired/prepared repertoire entry is required. There is no new upcast, cost waiver, school access or component substitute. Deep Crust Spike, Molecular Destabilization, Incendiary Cloud, Dimensional Break and Illusory Wall of Doom require one Action and V/S/F. Soul Pyre uses one Action and V/S plus the actual Core M/F alternative, without an invented priced or consumed reagent; its real corpse is indispensable effect fuel under RD8-PYRE-02. A focus cannot substitute for that body.
Direct cast preflight checks the actual Action, components, permitted source, declared mode, legal selection, range, perception and line of effect. Known invalid selection causes no commitment or cost. Pay the actual final RP/material/other real costs and establish required concentration before the actual single casting-interruption window. Dissonance is read before payment: limit max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)), surcharge +1/+2/+3 at limit/limit+3/limit+6, ordinary ranked casting barred at limit+6 without its actual explicit exception. This rank contributes base 2 plus same-name Refrain +1/+2/+3 capped, subject only to the real class's protected rules. First prepared Wizard family use retains its actual base-risk exemption; Mage Focus/chain, Druid and Cleric engines keep their real triggers. A miss, save, counter or late no-effect outcome refunds nothing and never restores displaced concentration. Spell DC is 8+PB+actual casting modifier plus actual acquired modifiers; saves are binary, not critical successes or degrees.
Ordinary Ready is unchanged. At preparation fix spell/non-target mode, provide components, pay and record that one cast, take its counter window and hold concentration. Select the legal creature/corpse/point and target-dependent orientation at release, after the completed perceived trigger, spending the actual Reaction and rechecking current eligibility. No second RP/components/cadence/counter window is created. Soul Pyre's fuel identity is selected at release like its actual target, not reserved or consumed at preparation; this is the explicitly selected spell-specific fuel transaction, not a new general material rule. Ready does not require reserving a corpse already present at preparation: actual non-target casting components and a legal Ready setup are required then; no valid corpse at a later trigger means no release Reaction, and the paid hold keeps only its original deadline. The held spell expires at next regular own START or its actual earlier limit. Effect clocks begin on establishment at release. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 concerns the seven copied-feat profiles, not these ordinary casts; this cohort receives no feat allowance charge.

selectedSharedRules.wording: NEW express adoption for these six of DC25's continuous 3D Euclidean, closed-volume geometry and frozen-event recipient selection, not a global replacement of historical grids. A scene supplies actual body volumes, source origins, sensory paths, support, opaque barriers and stable entity order. Range is evaluated from the actual caster origin to the selected point or actual creature/body witness according to the local procedure; a convenient visual/center point outside a body never substitutes for a legal witness. At a manifestation freeze its actual geometry and eligible recipients before consequences; later cover destruction, body movement or death does not add recipients to that same event. Recheck the original identities when each pending component executes; no replacement target is selected. Closed volume/body boundary contact counts for these area spells, including large bodies whose centers lie outside. The same intersection witness must have the specified origin line of effect. Total cover blocks; no floor/wall penetration or hidden-entity scan is granted. Private engine eligibility may determine non-admission without revealing its cause. Source-specific component immunity and genuine lesser-antimagic expression suppression precede creation of a damage application. A geometrically missing or wholly suppressed recipient produces no root or save. A spell does not affect an inanimate object merely because a creature is holding it, unless its own procedure expressly specifies non-damage corpse fuel or custody cleanup.

selectedSharedRules.wording:
Reuse actual Core, class, condition, sharing and Null interfaces in their accepted scope; NEW exact root mapping for these six: the original caster is the dealer. Each genuinely admitted original recipient gets one root. For these area events, after the event's actual geometry/admission/family checks and before any recipient consequences, create all of its admitted recipient roots using the actual original-caster Null state at that event checkpoint. Those roots remain distinct and keep that snapshot throughout this one batch. A body which subsequently ceases to exist receives no fabricated packet, and an unused root creates no effect/resource. For single-target events create the root at that damage checkpoint. Deep Crust Spike's two types and Soul Pyre's two types stay one event/root for that recipient. The wall's one collapse is one event per admitted recipient. Molecular Destabilization and Dimensional Break each have one force event. Incendiary Cloud creates fresh original-caster roots for the separately authorized pulse's admitted recipients before any of that pulse's consequences, expressly reevaluating that caster's current unsuppressed Null flag at each pulse; it is not one inherited whole-cloud root. This mapping does not alter Spectral Army, Mental Prison or any other source's root policy.
A root under unsuppressed Null Veil retains that flag in its typed components and pure transfers. Later Veil changes do not rewrite an existing root. Different recipients/casts/pulses remain distinct even if sharing one raw pool. Resolve real typed mitigation/prevention and source-specific sharing at their actual stages, then temp HP, normal HP and accepted lifecycle once per terminal recipient. A post-defense transfer that prohibits repeat mitigation or derived recovery retains those restrictions. A redirected damage portion never moves the spell's original rider to the new damage recipient. ActualDamageDealt is temp HP absorbed plus normal HP lost, not overkill; none of these spells creates recovery, soul custody, capture permission or resources merely by dealing damage.
For an ordinary living damage event, evaluate Instant Death using post-temp remainder versus pre-event HP and effective maximum; if not instantly dead, actual positive-to-zero or at-least-half-maximum damage requires the real Wound save (CON DC max(10,floor(post-temp damage/2)), with existing Wound penalties), without inventing Maiming. Actual zero-HP and Wound/death replacements complete before a later spell rider. Null living branches suppress this damage's Instant Death and Wound/Maiming save; positive-to-zero establishes Stable0 under its actual recovery clock, while existing Dying0 and Stable0 keep their distinct recorded states/clocks. Actual finite or nonliving recipients use their own reviewed lifecycle, not a generic guessed anatomy. Costs, corpse consumption, source expiry and concentration endings remain non-damage consequences under Null.
Damage to a concentrating creature still invokes its actual concentration procedure, DC max(10,floor(resolved damage/2)), including real temp-HP absorption. Separate later Falling is its own ordinary consequence; no fictional crush or immediate landing packet is attached. All same-event class/passive hooks require their real acquisition, timing and eligibility. Re-evaluate ongoing source validity after response/concentration/life processing before a pending ongoing component establishes.

selectedSharedRules.wording:
NEW RD8-MIXED-02 applies ONLY to Deep Crust Spike, Soul Pyre and actually authorized descendants of those packets. It does not grant a reduction or change Meteor Spear/Ice Storm. Roll the explicitly partitioned pools once; apply the spell's save factor independently to each type with floor. Select one strongest competing class flat reduction for the whole event under CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES, not one reduction before resistance plus another afterward. If eligible competing amounts tie and no more specific source selects, use source-card/mechanical ID, then original owner ID, then application ID, lexical and fixed before mitigation outcomes. This explicitly chosen tie key follows the complete Ice Storm precedent rather than silently replacing Meteor's different key. A selected ordinary class reduction acts before typed resistance; Spinal Plating acts after resistance only if it is the selected actually acquired active eligible source. A single-target Deep Crust Spike is not an area merely because its eruption has an origin; area-only Spinal Plating does not qualify there.
At the selected aggregate stage combine like canonical types. For nonnegative eligible amounts a_i, A=sum(a_i), allocate B=min(actual reduction,A). If A=0 allocate nothing. Assign floor(B*a_i/A), then distribute remaining integer points by greatest exact fractional remainder and lexical canonical damage-type ID ties. Zero/ineligible types receive no share, no type goes negative, and later immunity/resistance cannot be used to optimize the prior allocation. Apply each actual resistance/immunity and rounding once at its proper stage. Retain typed residuals through any source-qualified transfer; a post-mitigation transfer is not mitigated again. Finish one Core/lifecycle/concentration event per terminal recipient, not one per damage type.

A single-target spell rolls its one recipient pool. A cloud pulse rolls anew only if it has at least one admitted eligible exposure; a wholly suppressed/no-recipient pulse is recorded as missed without manufacturing a damage roll. Conditional later branches draw only when genuinely required. Native faces, totals, eligibility identities, random seeds and future draws remain private engine evidence. selectedSharedRules.wording:
Apply actual named suppressors and removal sources, not generic antimagic by name. Rank-8 spells are outside Globe's rank-0–5 boundary; Globe does not stop them on that basis. Lesser Antimagic has no rank ceiling: validate its actual source region, line of effect and expression location. A legal cast inside suppression may pay and then fail to manifest; casting is not retroactively free. An instantaneous event blocked at its actual manifestation/original-recipient locus produces no postponed payload on later emergence. Already completed damage, movement and corpse consumption are not undone by a later dispel. Real changed objects and gear remain real.
The cloud and surviving wall image have original establishment+60-second concentration deadlines, with expiry winning at equality; suppression does not pause them or create a new pulse/collapse. Partial field suppression removes only the actual intersecting expression under the suppressor; it does not erase an out-of-field region or prevent an already remote field merely because its caster later enters. Full generating-source removal or concentration loss ends remaining expression. Dimensional Break's established exile instead uses the expressly adopted permanent closure on actual application suppression/removal. Source-body/caster death or incapacitation follows actual concentration rules, not an invented remote cancellation predicate. Greater Dispel Magic keeps generating rank 8 and its actual high-rank check DC26; a differently scoped Wizard Dispel Magic class card keeps its own DC18 and costs. No generic spell sharing, reset or returned material is created by cleanup.

DEEP CRUST SPIKE — NEW RD8-SPIKE-02; preserves 10d8 total and both printed types.
ACCESS / CAST: Druid, Mage or Wizard with actual rank-8 Transmutation access, minimum class level15; one Action, base21RP, V/S/F; instantaneous, no continuing concentration. Apply all routed RD8 shared rules.
SELECTION / UPWARD ORIGIN: Choose one actually perceived creature with an actual current body/occupied volume, and a genuinely known upward-facing solid supporting surface below it. No creature type is excluded by its name. NEW single-target completion: choose an actual point on that surface directly below an intersection with the target's current body in the scene's real gravity frame; at most30 feet of unobstructed upward separation is allowed. Both selected origin and the body witness must be within120 feet of the caster's actual source origin. Require actual caster-to-origin line of effect and origin-to-the-same-body-witness vertical line of effect. The source point must be perceivable/known by an actually sufficient sense, not a guessed hidden floor. Ordinary solid floors, ground, ice, decks or supported platforms can supply the surface; there is no invented stone-only requirement. A ceiling overhead is not a below-origin. Water or open air alone supplies no solid surface, but a genuinely perceived solid bottom with an unobstructed path through actual transparent water can qualify. A floating creature can be struck within the stated30-foot vertical reach; flight is not blanket immunity. A floor, closed hull or intervening body/terrain blocker is not penetrated. No subterranean depth, minimum crust thickness or tunneling is manufactured.
This is a targeted eruption, not a damaging cylinder: no other creature is hit merely for crossing the line or standing nearby. The target, selected origin and geometry are fixed for the event. Revalidate the same target and origin after interruption; no retarget, alternate floor or favorable origin shift. A known missing surface, excessive gap or cover fails preflight without payment; a genuinely changed late predicate after a paid legal commitment prevents that payload without refund. Ordinary Ready chooses these target-dependent facts at release.

Failure takes both complete typed pools; success takes floor(fire/2) and floor(piercing/2). Apply RD8-MIXED-02, current defenses and one grouped damage event/root. Immunity to one type does not erase the other; no attack roll, crit, vulnerability bypass or rider is implied. Actual resulting Wounds, zero/death, concentration and body lifecycle resolve normally.

No real platform, spear, tunnel, terrain cost, harvestable lava, persistent fire, structural/object damage, forced movement, knock-up, restraint, Prone or additional Falling packet is granted. It changes no gear custody or anatomy beyond independently earned Core consequences. completeSpellRules.procedure:
SOUL PYRE — NEW RD8-PYRE-02; explicitly8d6 total, split4d6 fire plus4d6 necrotic.
ACCESS / CAST: Cleric, Druid or Wizard with actual rank-8 Necromancy access, minimum class level15; Action, base21RP, V/S and the actual M/F alternative. No priced reagent is invented. A reusable focus can satisfy the focus alternative but cannot supply the real corpse that fuels the effect. Instantaneous; no continuing concentration outside a held Ready.
CORPSE / OWNERSHIP: Select one actually perceived, physically present principal corpse/remains body record, whose genuine death and origin are recorded and which is currently available and not already consumed or disallowed as a resource by its own source. NEW eligibility completion: one retained principal body identity is the unit, regardless of size, prior creature type or age; a severed part, pile assembled from fragments or duplicate reference is not another principal body. Ordinary missing-part history or skeletal principal remains does not alone prohibit it. No minimum body mass, percentage, humanoid-only, necromancy-only or arbitrary age cutoff is added. There must actually be one qualifying principal corpse now; unresolved global decay cannot be assumed to supply one. A Dying0/Stable0 living body is not eligible. No phantom body, copied form, already-consumed standard animated body or expired/destroyed finite summon supplies new fuel. A genuine Ranger beast corpse or a genuinely reconstructed body later dying can qualify only through its own actual current body history and permissions; no owner-level/CR test applies. This spell needs no consent from a deceased body's former controller, but neither transfers legal ownership of surviving gear nor asserts ownership/finality of any soul.
GEOMETRY: NEW separation of the two20-foot values: the corpse's fixed current body-origin/anchor must be within20 feet of the caster source, with genuine perception and line of effect. On effect resolution its actual current anchor is the center of a20-foot-radius closed3D sphere. Select all actual creatures with body intersection and center-to-the-same-witness line of effect, including the caster, allies and carrier. No favorable exclusions, objects or structural damage are implied. Real corpse inventory survives as described below. An actual acquired initial-area exclusion, such as the Wizard's Evocation-only benefit, applies only if its exact prerequisites hold; Soul Pyre is Necromancy and gains no Evocation permission by analogy.
ATOMIC FUEL TRANSACTION: NEW spell-specific choice: the corpse is selected but neither reserved nor consumed during commitment or its counter window. At resolution revalidate that same identity at its actual current anchor, still within range/LoE, source-eligible and available. A move that still satisfies all predicates moves the eventual blast center; an out-of-range move, prior consumption, actual return to life or other invalidation prevents the paid effect without a substitute or refund. Resolve simultaneous consumers in the established neutral authoritative event order. At the valid effect checkpoint atomically claim and mark this one body consumed, snapshot blast geometry/recipients and create the blast event. No later consumer can claim its old corpse; a previously provisional Auto-Raise reservation confers no priority over actual lawful consumption. A countered spell consumes no corpse. For Ready the actual corpse is selected/rechecked at release; there is no preparation-time corpse lock. This is not a global change to printed consumed spell materials.
DAMAGE: Each admitted creature makes a DEX save. One shared raw pool of four d6 fire and four d6 necrotic serves this blast. Failure takes each full type; success halves each type with floor before RD8-MIXED-02 and actual defenses. Separate recipient roots share the original caster as dealer, not the dead body's former owner. It remains one original-recipient event per creature, with source-qualified transfers, temp HP, life and concentration. Absence, immunity or suppression at a recipient does not refund consumed fuel or give a second blast. If the creating manifestation itself is wholly prevented at the fuel/source checkpoint, consumption does not begin. Zero admitted damage recipients still leaves a lawfully executed corpse-burning effect, but creates no unnecessary damage RNG or roots.
REMAINS / END: NEW physical completion: burn the principal body into spent ordinary ash/char at its actual location, retaining the same consumed-body lineage and missing-part/corpse history. Never create a second corpse/fuel/loot entitlement by splitting ashes. Surviving worn, carried or lodged real items are not consumed or automatically damaged by the spell; detach them locally at their actual positions under ordinary support/fall rules, preserving IDs and provenance. No remote deposit or inventory deletion. Actual non-damage material consumption is not converted by Null. Later dispel cannot restore the corpse or refund costs. A separate reconstruction/resurrection source must independently support these actual spent remains, its costs and restrictions; this spell grants neither such a recovery nor a metaphysical ban on it. Soul Pyre supplies no soul capture, RP, healing or resource-return rider.

completeSpellRules.procedure:
INCENDIARY CLOUD — NEW RD8-CLOUD-02, explicitly resolving the Instantaneous/per-round conflict.
ACCESS / CAST: Mage or Wizard with actual rank-8 Evocation access, minimum class level15; Action, base21RP, V/S/F. NEW chosen ongoing behavior: concentration up to60 seconds from actual establishment, not an instantaneous single hit. Select one actually perceived center within20 feet of the caster with line of effect; create a fixed20-foot-radius closed3D sphere. The source range20 and printed radius20 are independently retained. No free movement of the center or tether to the moving caster is created.
PULSES: NEW express extension of P20-CLOCKS-01 and P20-FAMILY-EXPOSURE-01 only to this identity. Attempt a pulse at establishment t0 and t0+6,+12,...,+54 seconds. Expiry at t0+60 wins at equality; no final+60 pulse. These source-owned events require no caster/recipient/companion turn and grant none. At each pulse recompute actual creature/body intersection and center-to-witness line of effect, then freeze its eligible exposure set before damage. Include caster and allies. Entry, exit, reentry, forced movement, an extra turn, birth-round companion phase or suppression ending supplies no extra pulse. Entering between pulses is not immediate damage; genuine absence at a pulse means no exposure.
The per-recipient Incendiary Cloud family ledger permits at most one admitted cloud exposure per numbered round across all owners/casts. Outside initiative use the scene's continuing six-second exposure interval fixed before the exposure, preserving spent history when mapped into combat; changing timing mode never refreshes it. Earliest actually admitted opportunity claims the family slot; simultaneous eligible sources use established application order then stable source identity. Save, immunity or later prevention after admission still consumes it. Wholly suppressed or geometrically ineligible expressions do not claim it, so another actually eligible cloud later that round can act. Retain each cast's separate concentration, source/pulse history and original deadline; no strongest-damage reroll/selection. This ledger is new for this family only, not a universal area cap.
RESOLUTION: At each actual authorized exposure, DEX save against that cloud's caster DC; failure10d8 fire, success floor(total/2). One fresh shared10d8 pool per pulse with at least one admitted recipient. Apply current real defenses and one distinct root/event per recipient; original caster's current Null flag is sampled anew at each pulse, expressly not inherited from cloud creation. No attack/crit, smoke poison, Burn rider or additional recoil. Real concentrating recipients make their real concentration saves after damage. Complete actual lifecycle before later events. A source can be torn down during a pulse by the normal consequences, but the already-snapshotted pulse is not resampled to erase or add recipients; its initially fixed pulse event resolves, then its future pulses cease. This is a NEW cloud-only batch completion for that already-created event, not a delay of unrelated concentration consequences.
ACTUAL CLASS FEATURES: A Wizard's qualifying Evocation initial-area exclusion can omit its one actual chosen creature only at the creation pulse; it does not mark that body immune to later pulses. Mage Focus/Surge and other abilities apply only through their actual eligible use; the spell grants no free chosen-element casts or extra concentration. An extinguished target or vanished summon is not recreated at later ticks.
PHYSICS / SUPPRESSION: This is a visible, translucent magical fire-and-cinder field, not a borrowed physical-gas stat block. Its appearance changes no mechanical illumination state; existing actual lighting/senses determine visibility. It creates no heavy/light obscuration, blindness, breathable-air removal, smoke, wind transport, water extinguishing rule, material ignition, residual fuel, difficult terrain or object damage. Real existing fog, walls, water, wind and sources continue under their own actual rules. A real opaque blocker prevents its relevant rays; it is not destroyed to reach bodies beyond it. Lesser Antimagic suppresses only its actual clipped intersecting expression, with no paused clock or catch-up. The fixed source's center is not a new emitter creature. A paid cast whose actual creation is suppressed establishes no banked cloud. During a valid ongoing cloud, covered recipient portions do not produce qualifying hits unless an actual unsuppressed intersection witness remains under the accepted suppressor geometry. Caster later entering antimagic does not alone erase a remote valid field. Concentration end, source removal or deadline ends the field and all future pulses; completed damage and independently earned real life states remain.

completeSpellRules.procedure:
DIMENSIONAL BREAK — NEW RD8-BREAK-02, force packet plus actual temporary exile.
ACCESS / CAST: Cleric, Mage or Wizard with actual rank-8 Universal access, minimum class level15; Action, base21RP, V/S/F,120 feet. Choose one actually perceived creature the caster designates as an enemy from its own knowledge, with ordinary source-to-body line of effect; this grants no hostility scan. NEW target completion: that same creature is the recipient of both printed components; there is no unprinted force area. Actual absence, corpse or false-image noncreature eligibility does not become a target. Independent transport prevention does not make the otherwise legal force target invalid.
DURATION / COMMITMENT: NEW resolution of Core Instantaneous: the8d10 force is instantaneous, but this cast requires concentration at commitment for its prospective exile. Old incompatible concentration ends even if this cast is countered or its exile later fails. An established cell lasts no more than60 seconds from that establishment; effect expiry is not extended by saves, suppression or return conflict. If no exile establishes, end this cast's unused concentration burden after its pending resolution. A wholly countered cast grants neither component and refunds nothing. An ordinary Ready takes one preparation/counter transaction and selects the actual enemy at legal release; this is not the copied-feat allowance rule.
FORCE FIRST: Roll one DEX save and exactly8d10 force; failure full total, success floor(total/2). Resolve genuine defenses, source-qualified transfer, temp HP, Core/Null life changes, any real concentration/death replacements and response windows. Caster owns its one original damage root. Force immunity or zero actual HP loss does not inherently prevent exile. Conversely a transport bar or spent hard-removal allowance does not retroactively cancel damage. A damage recipient created by transfer is not the exile target. Actual death/removal before exile means no creature to exile; a living Dying0/Stable0 or an extant source-qualified NullDisabled body is not automatically a corpse, and remains eligible if its actual lifecycle permits transport. Do not manufacture immediate death from zero HP.
EXILE SECOND: Recheck the same original creature, surviving generating source/concentration, current range/perception/LoE, actual transport/custody predicates and one-live-cell eligibility. No retarget, second RP/cast or extra force packet. Before the exile CHA save record the target's actual ACCEPT/RESIST intent, using an authorized controller/actual creature decision; inability to consent is RESIST, not guessed willingness. ACCEPT may voluntarily fail or roll; a failed rolled ACCEPT remains voluntary transport. RESIST uses the actual CHA save. Success ends only the exile attempt. A legal failed/voluntary-failed admission consumes the caster-to-target hard-removal allowance only on actual successful establishment; blocked admission consumes no new hard-control history and has no fallback stun/control. No Escape blocks voluntary ACCEPT transportation only; teleport-only restrictions do not silently block forced extraplanar removal, while an actual Dimensional Anchor endpoint predicate does. Preserve each named source's scope. If an already-known bar makes exile impossible, do not fabricate a diagnostic save/root merely to reveal it; resolve the force and silently no exile.
EXPLICIT CELL EXTENSION: RD8-BREAK-CELL-02 expressly extends BAN-CELL-03, BAN-ADMIT-03, BAN-CLOSE-03, BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02, BAN-CONFLICT-04 and BAN-PLACEMENT-HANDOFF-03 to this spell's exile, with only the stated rank8/range120/force-first differences. This is an added named user, not a global teleport/cosmology rule. It shares the one-live spell-cell primary-admission slot with ordinary Banishment: no refresh, replacement or nested second primary cell for the same creature. A Break already targeting such a creature through an actually lawful path can still resolve its force; the slot bars only a second exile. This reciprocal slot check is an explicit new integration requirement, not a claim that old Banishment code already checks Break.
At admission snapshot actual origin plane as an opaque existing reference, fixed world anchor/orientation and current body/gear. It creates an unnamed ephemeral cell, not a chosen known plane or a traversable gate. Primary center is local(0,0), floor z0, original orientation, with5-foot free clearance around its current body on each side and above; round full enclosure dimensions up to5-foot increments. The floor supports the admitted body and the cell provides ordinary nonharmful illumination and an appropriate nonharmful respiration medium. It is not a source of harvested air, floor, material or loot. Its opaque boundary blocks ordinary sight, sound and line of effect. No view of an external hidden destination is granted.
Creature remains able to act, move, concentrate, use actual resources, receive scheduled saves/death checks/recharges and undergo real damage/life consequences on the same advancing clock. Exile is not unconsciousness, healing, an extra turn or time stop. Only actual carried/worn noncreature possessions within real custody/capacity travel with the primary. Mounts, passengers and carried creatures do not ride free; retain the exact separability/physical restraint checks, and fail the transport atomically if required genuine separation is impossible. Dropped gear stays where it actually belongs.
Visitors require their own actual legal source, destination knowledge, path/fit and costs under BAN-ADMIT-03; this spell grants none. Voluntary form change/internal creation must fit the current cell before any later permitted adjustment. Mandatory actual body/life changes still happen, and only then extend the cell just enough to contain the extant bodies plus the required clearance. Secondary bodies retain stable admission and projected origin-anchor metadata. No new attack profile, rating or companion turn is created.
ENDING / RETURN: Deadline, concentration/source end, actual valid dispel or suppression of the exile application closes it permanently once; suppression is not a pause/resume. The caster entering an unrelated remote antimagic field is not itself suppression of this cell's actual application. Primary legal escape also closes the cell but does not drag the escaped creature back. Remaining actual bodies/corpses/objects return; vanished, consumed or escaped things are not recreated. The gate image is not an extra transport route.
Use the complete copied BAN closure/placement authority: return remaining extant entities to the snapshotted origin plane before physical fitting; primary first then secondary creatures by stable admission, actual gear with carriers and loose surviving objects by their projected current local offset. The origin anchor does not move with a later vehicle. NEW expressly inherited terminal-only exception ignores a true endpoint transport-prevention predicate solely for mandatory cell closure, never physical occupancy/walls/anatomy or a future voluntary journey. Try actual current body at its anchor, then a legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region by minimum displacement, greatest overlap, fixed neutral board order. No remote search, wall crossing, occupied-space passage, healing or fresh turn.
If no fit exists, the cell still ends and the same entity is on its origin plane with canonical placementConflict and anchor metadata, no fictional overlapping footprint or invented universal Action ban. Ordinary conditions, clocks, exposure, life and lawful displacement permissions continue under that interface. Resolve only when a genuinely legal placement becomes available; no reserved sanctuary. Evaluate Falling only after a legal current footprint actually lacks support. Corpses return as corpses, dropped gear is not restored, and the force damage is never undone.
